events.title: 텔아비브에서 태어나다
events.description_en: He was born in Tel Aviv, in Mandatory Palestine.

events.title: 테크니온을 마치고 미국으로 건너가다
events.title_en: He finished the Technion and emigrated to the United States
events.description: 테크니온에서 전자공학 학사를 마쳤다. 같은 해 미국으로 건너가 대학원 공부를 이어갔다.
events.description_en: He earned a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from the Technion. That same year he emigrated to the United States to continue his graduate studies.

events.title: 브루클린 폴리테크닉에서 박사 학위를 받다
events.title_en: He received his doctorate from the Polytechnic Institute of Brooklyn
events.description: 브루클린 폴리테크닉 대학에서 전자공학 박사 학위를 받았다.
events.description_en: He earned a doctorate in electrical engineering from the Polytechnic Institute of Brooklyn.

events.title: UCLA에서 공학을 가르치기 시작하다
events.title_en: He began teaching engineering at UCLA
events.description: UCLA에서 공학 강의를 맡으며 학계 경력을 시작했다. 이듬해 새로 생긴 컴퓨터과학과 교수가 되었다.
events.description_en: He began his academic career teaching engineering at UCLA. The following year he became a professor in the newly formed Computer Science Department.

events.title: 베이지안 네트워크를 책으로 펴내다
events.title_en: He published his book on Bayesian networks
events.description: 불확실한 정보를 다루는 계산 체계로 베이지안 네트워크를 제시한 『Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems』를 펴냈다. 인공지능이 확률을 다루는 방식을 바꾼 저작이다.
events.description_en: He published Probabilistic Reasoning in Intelligent Systems, laying out Bayesian networks as a calculus for reasoning under uncertainty. The book changed how artificial intelligence handled probability.

events.title: 두-계산법을 논문으로 처음 밝히다
events.title_en: He first set out the do-calculus in a paper
events.description: 인과관계를 수식으로 다루는 두-계산법을 논문으로 처음 발표했다. 상관관계와 인과관계를 가르는 도구를 마련한 셈이다.
events.description_en: He first set out the do-calculus, a formal system for reasoning about causation, in a published paper. It gave researchers a tool for telling correlation apart from causation.

events.title: 『Causality』를 펴내다
events.description: 인과관계를 상관관계로부터 엄밀하게 가려내는 방법을 담은 『Causality: Models, Reasoning, and Inference』를 펴냈다.
events.description_en: He published Causality: Models, Reasoning, and Inference, setting out rigorous methods for separating causal relationships from mere correlation.

events.title: 아들 대니얼이 파키스탄에서 살해되다
events.title_en: His son Daniel was killed in Pakistan
events.description: 월스트리트저널 기자였던 아들 대니얼 펄이 카라치에서 취재 중 납치돼 살해됐다. 부부는 이후 아들의 이름을 딴 재단에 힘을 쏟았다.
events.description_en: His son Daniel Pearl, a Wall Street Journal reporter, was kidnapped and killed while reporting in Karachi. He and his wife afterward devoted themselves to a foundation bearing their son's name.

events.title: 대니얼 펄 재단을 세우다
events.title_en: He founded the Daniel Pearl Foundation
events.description: 아내와 함께 대니얼 펄 재단을 세워 아들이 지녔던 객관성과 문화 간 이해라는 가치를 이어가고자 했다.
events.description_en: With his wife he founded the Daniel Pearl Foundation to carry forward his son's values of objectivity and cross-cultural understanding.

events.title: 튜링상을 받다
events.description: 확률적·인과적 추론을 다루는 계산 체계를 세운 공로로 컴퓨터과학 최고 영예인 튜링상을 받았다.
events.description_en: He received the Turing Award, computer science's highest honor, for founding a calculus of probabilistic and causal reasoning.

events.title: 『The Book of Why』를 펴내다
events.title_en: He published The Book of Why
events.description: 일반 독자를 겨냥해 인과관계 이론을 풀어 쓴 『The Book of Why』를 펴냈다. 상관관계에 머문 통계학의 한계를 지적했다.
events.description_en: He published The Book of Why, a general-audience account of causal reasoning. It pointed to the limits of a statistics confined to correlation.
